primitives.law: control/model/egress ownership is explicit and independently inspectable
IKANT_OWNED requires iKant-controlled model invocation ingress
IKANT_OWNED requires durable session runtime identity
valid explicit RELEASE_TO_HOST is terminal for the current ownership epoch
initial acquisition and reacquisition of IKANT_OWNED require explicit ACTIVATE_IKANT with fresh valid ownership proof
ordinary owned turns use an already materialized runtime with no GitHub transfer; warm activation must complete within 10000 ms
mass qualification is install/CI evidence and is forbidden from the ordinary turn path
repository/runtime contract coherence must re-check before ownership promotion
same evidence plus same state cannot repeat an activation action without changed evidence

common.ownership_rule: IKANT_OWNED iff runtime_bound + explicit ACTIVATE_IKANT + P0..P3 + P5..P8 close, no integrity fault/release/repeat violation, warm activation is observed within 10000 ms, and no mass qualification or GitHub transfer occurs in the ordinary turn path
